separate_canonical_failure.limit: No original SQLite message/code was retained here. Do not attribute DB_ERROR to the 0.5s timeout or claim native startup blocked this request. No missing usage is rewritten as authoritative zero.

minimal_robust_direction: Keep controller/checkpoint ownership and all mutations on one owner. Split the watchdog/accounting tick from blocking multi-GET facade calls; retain one coalesced read worker per lane, never a new worker every tick.

Keep the <=1s watchdog sampling and original 120s clock active while reads are pending. Pending/stale coverage blocks admissions and is not fresh accounting. A single slow read must not block deadline/control selection.

Use a separate bounded canonical control path, persist its immutable intent/action before dispatch, and observe that same intent/receipt with GET only. Never replay a productive/control POST to repair uncertainty, never abandon an owned worker on timeout, and join readers before releasing stores/ownership.
Remove the blanket .5 transport override only as part of this separation; merely increasing it in the synchronous loop does not preserve the monitor/deadline contract.

Publish the first safe failure classification: method, route template, canonical code/stage, configured timeout, monotonic elapsed, and phase. Never publish response bodies, messages, headers, SQL, auth or provider output.

On terminal opening refusal without a stream, retain the canonical failure and reservation, distinguish unavailable usage from observed usage, and stop the lane without fabricating an epoch or dispatching again.
Do not exit interrupt/close observation via all([]); distinguish owner-process stop from canonical control selection and preserve explicit unresolved outcomes.
focused_test_recommendations_not_execute: A coalesced read held on a synthetic Event beyond0.5s: <=1s watchdog ticks continue, at most one reader exists, no second admission, original120s deadline selects control once without waiting for that reader.
A terminal PREPARATION_FAILED opening with no stream: preserve exact canonical reason, no invented usage/epoch, no replay or second productive request.
Interrupt resolve response uncertainty with stops=[]: do not falsely exit as reconciled; GET the same intent, never repeat POST, preserve can_submit=false/session_not_ready honestly.
Final receipt GET failure after an earlier observation fault: preserve first error metadata, select no second control, retain/join owned readers and produce a bounded public result.
